target: Let G_n be the random graph on [n] in which each unordered vertex pair is independently an edge with probability 1/2. For a finite graph H, define theta(H)=max sum_{u,v} X_{u,v}, over real positive-semidefinite X with trace(X)=1 and X_{u,v}=0 for every edge uv of H. Prove that E[theta(G_n)]/sqrt(n) tends to 1 as n tends to infinity, or rigorously prove that this limit is not 1.
title: Lovasz theta of G(n,1/2)
